title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Iron Boulder ex Cyber Judge 041/071 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Iron Boulder ex 041/071 RR from the Cyber Judge set is a formidable addition to any Pokémon TCG collection. With its full art alternative design, this card showcases the formidable Iron Boulder ex in all its glory, illustrated by Hitoshi Ariga. The card features a multi-color finish, highlighting the ancient, abnormal, and rock creature/monster type's unique aesthetic.

This Japanese card is a basic stage Pokémon with a substantial 240 HP, ready to take on any challenge in your next battle. Manufactured in 2024 by Nintendo, it meets the standards of quality and excitement fans expect from the Pokémon Trading Card Game. This double rare card is a must-have for enthusiasts and collectors alike, offering a unique piece of the Pokémon universe.
